summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented but untested: I could not run the test suite or any repository code, per the instructions, so everything was verified by reading only. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; the JSON renderable and __main__ entry point in new rich/json.py; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; new tests test_print_json (tests/test_console.py) and test_rich_print_json (tests/test_rich_print.py); docs in console.rst, reference.rst, and new reference/json.rst; CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Deviation: the spec's overflow "none" is not a valid Rich value, so I used "ignore". The exact ANSI expectation in test_print_json was derived by hand and is the most likely failure point. Nothing was committed.
